description: MDMCS: A Benchmark Dataset for Multi-Damage Monitoring of Concrete Structures is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors pengwei guo, Yi Bao (Stevens Institute of Technology). Concrete structures deteriorate over time due to environmental exposure and mechanical stress, leading to various types of damage such as cracking, spalling, corrosion, and exposed rebar. Automated detection using deep learning-based computer vision techniques is limited by the lack of high-quality, annotated datasets. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
